notes: Copy this file to `<repo>/distill-config.json` (or anywhere; pass the path when invoking the skill).
All MCPs are optional. Set enabled=false (or omit the block entirely) for any tool you do not have.
fs and git are always available. Passes gracefully fall back to code-only mining when MCPs are absent.
hints.avoid_topics and hints.focus_topics are appended to every pass's subagent prompt to keep it on-domain.
Set passes.<name>=false to skip that pass entirely.
For multi-repo projects, use `repos: ["org/a", "org/b"]` instead of `repo` under github. Same for jira `project_keys`.
